candidate_axiom.name: Topological Homology Invariance & Betti Number Preservation
candidate_axiom.statement: System dependency and communication graphs must preserve invariant Betti numbers under architectural transformations, ensuring that component decomposition neither introduces circular deadlock 1-cycles nor disconnects 0-simplex components.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Structural transformations that alter simplicial homology groups or create unchecked 1-cycles are rejected.

system_profile.archetype: Simplicial Complex Auditor & Betti Invariant Guard
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Component Dependency Graph] ──> [Simplicial Complex Mapper]
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                 [Homology Group Calculator]
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                 [Betti Number Invariant Guard]

Simplicial Complex Mapper.role: Converts module dependency networks into geometric simplicial complexes.
Simplicial Complex Mapper.invariant_rule: N-ary interactions are mapped to (N-1)-simplex faces.

Homology Group Calculator.role: Computes Betti numbers: beta_0 (connectivity) and beta_1 (1-cycles / deadlocks).
Homology Group Calculator.invariant_rule: Detects circular dependency traps via non-zero 1-cycle boundaries.

Betti Invariant Guard.role: Ensures topological homology is preserved across compilation transformations.
Betti Invariant Guard.invariant_rule: Rejects any candidate that introduces un-bracketed 1-cycles.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Brings topological data analysis into systems architecture (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Mathematically proves absence of circular deadlocks without combinatorial search (+0.0160).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Guarantees topological stability of generated system modules (+0.0130).

tradeoffs.strengths: Provably prevents circular deadlocks and orphaned subsystems.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires graph triangulation compute step during AST verification.

leaderboard.name: Constructive Proof Demarcation & Intuitionistic Type Witnessing
leaderboard.statement: An architectural invariant cannot be established by mere non-constructive contradiction; every accepted axiom must construct a computable computational witness that realizes the claimed invariant across every admissible system state.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Proofs of invariant preservation via law of excluded middle without an explicit executable witness term are rejected.

system_profile.topology_type: Dependent Type Checking & Term Extraction Pipeline
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Invariant Specification] ──> [Intuitionistic Type Checker]
                                           │
                                           ▼
                               [Witness Term Extractor]
                                           │
                                           ▼
                               [Executable Realizer Unit]

Intuitionistic Type Checker.role: Treats invariant statements as dependent type propositions in Martin-Löf type theory.
Intuitionistic Type Checker.invariant_rule: Rejects non-constructive proofs relying on double-negation elimination.

Witness Term Extractor.role: Synthesizes an executable lambda-calculus term realizing the type proposition.
Witness Term Extractor.invariant_rule: Extracted terms must be total and terminate within bounded steps.

Executable Realizer Unit.role: Executes witness programs against simulation states to guarantee operational validity.
Executable Realizer Unit.invariant_rule: Type preservation (subject reduction) must hold across state mutations.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Forces candidates into rigorous typed formalisms (+0.0090).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Immediately discards non-constructive assertions without simulation (+0.0160).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces structural axioms that are directly compilable with zero ambiguity (+0.0180).

tradeoffs.strengths: Guarantees that every committed axiom has a concrete, executable verification program.
tradeoffs.constraints: Strict formulation requirement that rejects valid heuristics lacking immediate constructive witnesses.
